_examples_comment: Swap any spoke above to use a different provider. Examples below:

_openai_example._note: Set OPENAI_API_KEY env var or add openai_api_key here

_ollama_fast._note: Local model, no API key. Fast, ~4.7 GB

_ollama_quality._note: Local model, no API key. Best quality, ~19 GB, slower

_openai_compatible_example._note: Any OpenAI-format API: Together, Fireworks, DeepSeek, LiteLLM, etc.
